title: Claude Code Adds Experimental Code Mode to Orchestrate Tool Calls with JavaScript
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/claude-code-mode/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1795090945761.jpg"/><p>Anthropic's experimental Code Mode lets Claude Code write JavaScript that chains, parallelizes, and filters Bash, Read, and Edit calls, with changes to how auto mode and hooks review those calls.</p> <i>By Daniel Dominguez</i>

title: Qwik 2.0 RC: Replaces HTML Comment Markers for Faster Reactivity and Out-of-Order Streaming
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/quik-2-streaming/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1794907611481.jpg"/><p>Qwik 2.0 Release Candidate, published on 1 October 2026, replaces v1's HTML comment markers with two script blocks that hold state and virtual node data. It adds experimental out-of-order streaming, async useComputed$, and cacheable route loaders. Qwik's benchmarks show v2 at 1.23x vanilla JavaScript, versus 2.59x for v1. A migration command is provided.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: GitHub Rebuilds the Copilot App's Diff Surface to Open Million-Line Pull Requests without Jank
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/github-pull-requests-rebuild/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1794747791339.jpg"/><p>GitHub engineers rebuilt the diff view in the Copilot app to handle a pull request with 2,200 files, over a million changed lines and 400 inline comments. The design separates fixed-height code rows from variable-height comment blocks, which are measured in batches near the viewport. Performance is checked through CI budgets and automated app runs.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Node.js Brings Debounce, Throttle, and PKCS#12 Parsing into Core Modules
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/nodejs-debounce-throttle/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1794593143949.jpg"/><p>Node.js 26.10.0 adds util.debounce() and util.throttle(), plus util.markPromiseAsHandled(), to the core library. It also introduces crypto.parsePKCS12() for reading .p12 and .pfx bundles, and extends the experimental Virtual File System to node:ffi. The additions reduce the need for some userland dependencies. Node.js 26 is now Active LTS.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>

title: Dropbox Shares How its In-House Cookie Auditor Tests Consent Behaviour across 200+ Web Surfaces
partialText: <img src="https://res.infoq.com/news/2026/11/dropbox-cookie-auditor/en/headerimage/generatedHeaderImage-1794331089979.jpg"/><p>Dropbox engineers described a Playwright-based auditor that checks cookie consent behavior across more than 200 web surfaces. It runs three tests per page: US visitor, EU visitor, and Global Privacy Control signal. Cookie rules are kept outside the code. A companion tool finds live URLs. Weekly reports separate likely violations from false positives.</p> <i>By Daniel Curtis</i>
